visual.general_description: Line graph of a single smooth black waveform (amplitude in µV against latency in ms) with a labelled P1 peak.
visual.detailed_description: A single black trace plotted on white axes. The y-axis is labelled Amplitude (µV) with printed ticks 0.65, 1.3, 1.95, 2.6, 3.25 and 3.9; the x-axis is labelled Latency (ms) with printed ticks 0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250 and 300. The trace starts near the left edge, rises to a small early bump, dips, then rises to its highest peak, which is labelled P1 above it. A horizontal dashed line from the peak to the y-axis carries the printed label 3.31 µV, and a vertical dashed line from the peak to the x-axis carries the printed label 125 ms. After the peak the trace falls with small undulations toward the right edge. A small printed code reading 3-80(B)A sits just below the left end of the trace; its meaning is not explained. No legend, second series, patient name or date is visible.

evidence.quote: This finding indicates that the hearing aid performed adequate amplification, suggestive of normal central auditory pathway development.
